definitions.full: H4173. morag מוֺרֶג noun masculine Isa 41:15 threshing-sledge (Late Hebrew id. ; ᵑ7 id. , South Arabic , , Frä 133 , compare Ba ZA ii.117 (loan-word in Arabic = ploughshare ); modern Dozy ii. 623, and Wetzst Z.für Ethnol. 1873, 270 ff. , Anderlind ZPV ix. 41 f. ( ploughshare and harrow ,)); — absolute ׳מ 41:15 ; plural מֹרִגִּים 2Sam 24:22 (+ הַבָּקָר כְּלֵי ); מוֺרִגִּים 1Chr 21:23 ; — threshing-sledges of Araunah, given by him to David for wood of sacrifice 2Sam 24:22 = 1Chr 21:23 ; figurative of Israel as instrument of ׳י 's judgment Isa 41:15 . On form of threshing-sledge (modern; slightly turned up in front, and set with sharp stones or pieces of iron), and threshing-rollers, see Benz Archaeology 209 f. Now Archaeology i.232f. Dr Amos, 227f . מוֺרָד see ירד . I. מוֺרָה see יָרֵא . p 432, 434
definitions.rootNote: or מֹרַג ; from an unused root meaning to triturate ;
